summary: Clear every failing readiness check on this repository's chain by records written through the CLI (the operator answering the two D1 questions), and end the explicit-id bundling workaround (WA-08) at the 0.37.0 release. FBS-241's round DEFINE records the freeze (GR-31).
approach: A chain-authoring round: the DEFINE stage (test-author) writes the records check by check, driven by node bin/rcf.js define readiness --check <stage> output; BUILD is expected to be empty unless a check is shown wrong for a CLI product, in which case its fix is a new criterion with an ADR first. The stage-keeper records the freeze after D1 to D6 pass.
deliverables: Chain records: REQ shape classifications, TAD data and security architecture, a Deploy target ADR, TAC interfaces and settled drafts, failure and must-not criteria or reasoned defineD4 opt-outs, closed sets, concern-ledger entries, recordShape fields, ownerRefs (test-author)
The operator's D1 profile answers, recorded through the CLI
notes: DEFINE part A, 2026-10-24 (test-author). Readiness at START: exit 4, chips D1-D6 and D8 failing, about 900 findings (readiness-start output, summarised in ADR ADR-4160). Flags: US tags (WORKAROUND, ADR ADR-4152); every criterion here is testOnly. DEFINE part B3, 2026-10-24 (test-author, stage-keeper ruling 8): this slice's round DEFINE commits the named readiness fixture trees under test/fixtures/readiness/ (clean, d0-discovery, d1-brief, d2-skeleton, d3-shapes, d4-stories, d5-crosscut, d6-consistency, d7-decisions and d8-freeze: a clean tree plus one tree built to fail each D-check, D0 to D8) and captures the chip golden test/fixtures/readiness/chips.json, as { "<tree>": "<its Chips line>" }, from the round-base bin, from packages/rcf-lite, with node test/_harness/goldens.js readiness-chips test/fixtures/readiness/chips.json, which the AC-20301-4 test compares with the Chips lines at HEAD. DEFINE part B3, 2026-10-24 (test-author, stage-keeper ruling 9): this slice's round DEFINE records the operator's GR-55 answers of 2026-10-24, surface "the running app" and register "product owner", in rcf/.identity/profile.md by the shipped write-back (an edit of that file, its Surface section reading runningApp and its Register section reading productOwner, with no other surface or register marker word in the file, since the AC-20303-1 test reads one whole-word marker per question), naming the operator and that date as their source, which the AC-20303-1 and AC-20303-3 tests read, and the DEFINE: commit that records it quotes both answers and that date (AC-20303-3).
title: Readiness D1 to D6 and D8 green on rcf-lite main: frozen --next is the default again once FBS-241's round DEFINE records the freeze (GR-31)
